description: Comms (scripts/comms/comms.gd): who you can call in flight and what they say. Ranges, prices, chances, the clearance rules and the lines. {you} is your ship's name, {them} theirs, {control} the station's traffic control. See docs/runtime/comms.md.

problems: Drive's cooked. Air's fine. Morale isn't.
Out of fuel and out of ideas.
Main engine's dead and so's the backup. We're drifting.
We burned too much on the last leg. Don't ask how.

you_clearance: {control}, this is {you}, inbound. Requesting a berth.
cleared: {you}, {control}. Cleared to berth {berth}. Collar's lit green. Try to hit it.
Copy, {you}. Berth {berth} is yours. Approach slow, we've just had it polished.
{you}, cleared for berth {berth}. Watch the paint.
hold: {you}, hold outside two kilometres. The {other} is coming out of the collar. You'll see them.
Negative on the collar for now, {you}. The {other} is undocking. Hold, and enjoy the view.
after_hold: {you}, the {other} is clear. Cleared to berth {berth}.
Collar's yours, {you}. Berth {berth}. Mind their wake.
already: You're already cleared, {you}. Berth {berth}. We're not saying it twice. That was twice.
fined: {you}, you docked without clearance. That's {fine} and a note on your file. Call in next time.
{you}, nobody cleared you for that collar. {fine}, and your name's on the board in red.
pad_cleared: {you}, pad control. Pad {berth} is yours. Beacon's on. Mind the dust.
Cleared to land on pad {berth}, {you}. Gear down, if you have gear.
camp_cleared: {you}? Yeah. Land on the flat bit. The flatter bit. Not that bit.
Pad's clear, more or less. Come down slow, the foreman's watching.
camp_fined: Next time, call before you drop on my camp. {fine} for the scare.
You land on my camp without a word? {fine}. And a word.
speed: {you}, you're doing {speed} inside two kilometres. Bleed it off or we start writing.
Freighter on approach, you're hot. Slow down. The station doesn't move out of the way.
greet: This is the {them}. What do you need?
{them}. Make it quick, we're on the clock.
patrol: Patrol {them}. Keep it slow near the station and we'll get along fine.
{them}, system patrol. Nothing to report, and we'd like it to stay that way.
fuel_offer: We can spare {t} tonnes at {price} a tonne. Port's cheaper, but the port's over there.
{t} tonnes, {price} a tonne. We'll come alongside. Hold still.
fuel_coming: On our way. Don't do anything clever.
fuel_wait: We can't line up a hose with you moving like that. Hold still.
Stop wriggling, {you}. We're trying to help.
fuel_done: {t} tonnes in. Bill's on its way. Fly safe.
fuel_no: We're doing {speed} the other way. Ask someone who's stopped.
We've barely enough for ourselves. Try a hauler at the port.
tow_offer: We'll take your line. Call it {fee}, and we don't discuss the parking.
We can tow you in for {fee}. It's that or wait for the port tug.
tug_offer: Port tug. {fee} to bring you in, same as always. Sit tight.
Tug here. {fee}, and keep your hands off the throttle.
news_tight: {place} is short of {goods}. Has been for days. You didn't hear it from us.
If you're carrying {goods}, {place} will kiss you. Metaphorically.
news_price: Prices at {place} are {dir} {pct} this week. Make of that what you will.
news_wreck: There's a dead ship out by the station, {km} km off: {wreck}. Nobody's touched it yet.
Saw a wreck on the way in, about {km} km out. {wreck}. Not our business.
news_none: Nothing worth the airtime. Quiet out.
No news. Which is news, round here.
news_again: We told you everything we know. Twice would be making it up.
sos: Mayday, mayday. This is the {them}, {species} registry. {problem} Anyone out there?
Any ship, any ship, this is the {them}. {problem} We've {crew} aboard.
sos_answer: You heard us? Oh, thank everything. Come alongside, we're not going anywhere.
{you}? We see you. Please don't be a salvage crew.
sos_fuel: Fuel? Bless you. {t} tonnes at {price} a tonne, and we owe you a drink.
{t} tonnes. We'll pay {price} a tonne and name a child after you. Small child.
sos_crew: You're taking us off? We'll grab our bags. Somebody grab the cat.
We're coming across. The ship can wait. We can't.
sos_room: You've no room? Then send word to the port. We'll keep the lights on.
sos_bye: We'll make it from here. Thank you, {you}. Really.
Fuelled up and limping home. We owe you.
